Calculate the frequency of the radiation that accompanies the transition of a hydrogen electron from the excited state n = 6 to the state n = 2. (R_H = 1.096776×10⁷ m⁻¹, c ≈ 3×10⁸ m/s)
(Transition n = 6 → n = 2 in hydrogen.) To which series of the atomic emission spectrum does this radiation belong? (Has the atom returned to its ground state?)
questions.explanation: Ending on n = 2 → Balmer; the atom is not back in its ground state (n = 1).
